component.name: Tobari
component.summary: A browser that closes over the window

description.p: Tobari is a Chromium browser for Linux that blocks ads and trackers at the network layer, before they load, and sends nothing home. It has no account system and no server.

ul.li: Network-level blocking with EasyList, EasyPrivacy and uBlock Origin's lists, controlled per site from the toolbar
DuckDuckGo-style !bangs resolved on your machine, so the search engine never sees a bang query
Private defaults: no search suggestions, no prediction, third-party cookies blocked
Chrome Web Store extensions, including password managers

description.p: Tobari does not claim to make you anonymous. Its threat model and every tradeoff it makes are published in SECURITY.md.

screenshot.caption: Chromium's window with the Tobari toolbar popup open
The new-tab page resolving a bang

description.p: Setup opens in its own window with search engine logos; Tobari's own pages under tobari://, like chrome://.
A first-run welcome flow to choose the search engine, appearance and privacy options; an AppImage; a macOS build for Apple silicon.
First development build: Chromium 154.0.8037.94 via CEF, built-in blocking, local bangs, private and hardened defaults, signed releases.
